transcript.en: Hi. Great to see you!
transcript.zh: 你们好，很高兴见到你们！

transcript.en: I'm Jody, and I'll be looking after both of you for the first month you're working here at the Amersham Theatre.
transcript.zh: 我叫Jody，你们两个在Amersham大剧院工作的第一个月都将由我来照看。

transcript.en: I'll tell you something about the theatre now, then take you to meet two of the other staff.
transcript.zh: 我现在先告诉你们一些剧院的情况，然后再带你们去见两位其他的员工。

transcript.en: It's an old building, and it's been modernised several times.
transcript.zh: 这是一栋老建筑，已经翻修了好几次了

transcript.en: In fact, as you can see, we're carrying out a major refurbishment at the moment.
transcript.zh: 事实上，你们也能注意到，我们现在就在进行一次大整修。

transcript.en: The interior has just been repainted, and we're about to start on the exterior of the building - that'll be a big job.
transcript.zh: 我们刚刚重新粉刷完建筑内部，正准备开始粉刷外部，那会是一项大工程。

transcript.en: The work's running over budget, so we've had to postpone installing an elevator.
transcript.zh: 这次工程的花费已经超出预算了，所以我们不得不推迟安装电梯的计划。

transcript.en: I hope you're happy running up and down stairs!
transcript.zh: 希望你们不会介意跑上跑下。

transcript.en: When the theatre was built, people were generally slimmer and shorter than now,
transcript.zh: 这座剧院最初建成的时候，人们的身材普遍比现在更苗条矮小，

transcript.en: and the seats were very close together.
transcript.zh: 所以那时的座位隔得非常近。

transcript.en: We've replaced them with larger seats, with more legroom.
transcript.zh: 我们已经把它们都换成大一些的座位了，放脚的地方也更多一点。

transcript.en: This means fewer seats in total, but we've taken the opportunity to install seats that can easily be moved, to create different acting spaces.
transcript.zh: 这就意味着我们全部座位的数量有所减少，不过我们趁着那次机会安装了能够轻易移动的座位，以创造出不同的表演空间。

transcript.en: We've also turned a few storerooms over to other purposes, like using them for meetings.
transcript.zh: 我们还把几间储藏室改装另作他用了，比如用作会议室之类的。

transcript.en: We try hard to involve members of the public in the theatre.
transcript.zh: 我们努力想要让观众朋友融入剧院。

transcript.en: One way is by organising backstage tours, so people can be shown round the building and learn how a theatre operates.
transcript.zh: 一种方法是组织人们参观后台，这样他们可以在建筑内四处游览并了解到一台戏剧是如何运作的。

transcript.en: These are proving very popular.
transcript.zh: 结果证明这种方法很受欢迎。

transcript.en: What we're finding is that people want to have lunch or a cup of coffee while they're here,
transcript.zh: 我们还发现人们希望能在这里吃个午餐或者喝杯咖啡，

transcript.en: so we're looking into the possibility of opening a café in due course.
transcript.zh: 所以我们剧院正在考虑在适当的时候开一家餐厅的可能性。

transcript.en: We have a bookshop, which specialises in books about drama, and that attracts plenty of customers.
transcript.zh: 这栋建筑中有一个书店专门出售与戏剧相关的书籍，这家书店吸引了非常多的顾客。

transcript.en: Then there are two large rooms that will be decorated next month,
transcript.zh: 下个月，我们还要装修两间大会议室，

transcript.en: and they'll be available for hire, for conferences and private functions, such as parties.
transcript.zh: 它们将被用于出租、开会或者像开派对这样的私人用途。

transcript.en: We're also considering hiring out costumes to amateur drama clubs.
transcript.zh: 我们还在考虑出租一些戏服给业余戏剧社团。

transcript.en: Now I want to tell you about our workshops.
transcript.zh: 现在我想向你们介绍一下我们的学习班。

transcript.en: We recently started a programme of workshops that anyone can join.
transcript.zh: 最近我们启动了一个任何人都能加入的学习班项目。

transcript.en: Eventually we intend to run courses in acting, but we're waiting until we've got the right people in place as trainers.
transcript.zh: 不过还得等找到合适人选担任培训师之后才能开始。

transcript.en: That's proving more difficult than we'd expected!
transcript.zh: 这比我们预料的要难得多。

transcript.en: There's a big demand to learn about the technical side of putting on a production,
transcript.zh: 大家在学习制作一台戏剧需要的技术方面的需求很大，

transcript.en: and our lighting workshop has already started, with great success.
transcript.zh: 我们的灯光学习班早已经开设了并且大获成功。

transcript.en: We're going to start one on sound next month.
transcript.zh: 我们下个月即将推出一门声音方面的课程。

transcript.en: A number of people have enquired about workshops on make-up, and that's something we're considering for the future.
transcript.zh: 已经有很多人向我们打听化妆学习班的情况了，所以我们考虑将来开一个这方面的课程。

transcript.en: A surprise success is the workshop on making puppets - we happen to have someone working here who does it as a hobby,
transcript.zh: 一个制作木偶的学习班意外地获得了成功。我们恰巧有个员工有这方面的爱好

transcript.en: and she offered to run a workshop.
transcript.zh: 她提出要开一个学习班，

transcript.en: It was so popular we're now running them every month!
transcript.zh: 没想到竟然这么受欢迎，我们现在每个月都开设这个课程。

transcript.en: Now, a word about the layout of the building.
transcript.zh: 现在我再提一下这栋建筑的布局。

transcript.en: The auditorium, stage and dressing rooms for the actors are all below ground level.
transcript.zh: 正厅、舞台和演员使用的更衣室全都在地下。

transcript.en: Here on the ground floor we have most of the rooms that the public doesn't see.
transcript.zh: 一楼的大部分房间都是观众看不见的。

transcript.en: The majority are internal, so they have windows in the roof to light them.
transcript.zh: 它们大多数都在内部，所以是通过屋顶上的窗户来采光的。

transcript.en: Standing here in the foyer, you're probably wondering why the box office isn't here,
transcript.zh: 站在门厅这儿的时候，你们可能会好奇，为什么售票处不在这里？

transcript.en: where the public would expect to find it.
transcript.zh: 观众能在哪里找到它？

transcript.en: Well, you might have noticed it on your way in – although it’s part of this building,
transcript.zh: 你们在进来的路上可能已经注意到了，虽然它仍是这栋建筑的一部分，

transcript.en: it's next door, with a separate entrance from the road.
transcript.zh: 但是它在路那边的单独入口处的旁边。

transcript.en: For the theatre manager's office, you go across the foyer and through the double doors,
transcript.zh: 要去剧院经理办公室的话，你们只要穿过门厅，

transcript.en: turn right, and it's the room at the end of the corridor, with the door on the left.
transcript.zh: 走过双开门之后右转，办公室就在左边有门的那条走廊的尽头。

transcript.en: The lighting box is where the computerised stage lighting is operated,
transcript.zh: 照明箱，也就是电脑控制舞台灯光的地方，

transcript.en: and it's at the back of the building.
transcript.zh: 在这栋建筑的背面。

transcript.en: When you're through the double doors,
transcript.zh: 当你们穿过双开门之后

transcript.en: turn left, turn right at the water cooler, and right again at the end.
transcript.zh: 向左转，然后在饮水机处右转，一直走到头之后再右转。

transcript.en: It's the second room along that corridor.
transcript.zh: 照明箱就在那条走廊上的第二间房里。

transcript.en: The lighting box has a window into the auditorium, which of course is below us.
transcript.zh: 照明箱里有一扇直通地下主厅的窗户。

transcript.en: The artistic director's office is through the double doors,
transcript.zh: 艺术总监的办公室在穿过双开门之后，

transcript.en: turn right, and it's the first room you come to on the right-hand side.
transcript.zh: 右转，你们右手边的第一个房间。

transcript.en: And finally, for the moment, the room where I'll take you next - the relaxation room.
transcript.zh: 最后，我暂且先带你们去休息室吧。

transcript.en: So if you'd like to come with me...
transcript.zh: 那么请你们跟我来......
